title: EcoToxFred: a knowledge-graph-grounded conversational agent for ecotoxicological monitoring and hazard data
description: EcoToxFred is a conversational agent that provides natural language access to a Neo4j knowledge graph of chemical monitoring and hazard data for European surface waters. This release includes the benchmark (questions, reference queries, evaluation code, and results) described in the accompanying manuscript.
